title: Operation of Hospitality Services 1
duration: 45 hours (30 hours of theory and 15 hours of discussion/practice)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop a service mindset and orientation towards customer service in the hospitality industry.
Understand the operational processes and services in hotels, including front desk, housekeeping, and food and beverage services.
Learn the management of service operations, including staffing, standards, and overall service processes.
Understand the organization and management of human resources in hotel services, including recruitment, training, and performance evaluation.
Develop adaptability, integration, and continuous learning in service operations management.
Understand the importance of health, professional ethics, environmental responsibility, and cultural values in service operations management.
